to: Sergeant J. M. Okafor, Marine Wing Support Squadron 000
via: Commanding Officer, Marine Wing Support Squadron 000

paragraphs.text: On 14 and 15 May 2026 you served as the range safety officer for the wing's motorcycle mentorship ride, a two day event that trained 38 Marines from six squadrons in group riding, hazard recognition, and mentorship of new riders.

Every one of the 38 completed both days, and 11 of them are now registered mentors in their squadrons' programs, which raises the wing's mentor count by a third. The wing has had no motorcycle mishap involving a mentored rider in the eighteen months the program has run, and events like this one are the reason.

You planned the route, briefed the safety plan each morning, and rode as the trail safety vehicle for both days on your own time. Please accept my sincere thanks for your part in the wing's program. A copy of this letter will be placed in your official record.
